name: VOD
description: Follow YouTube, Twitch and other online channels from Jellyfin: their videos appear in a library and are streamed on demand through yt-dlp, with nothing downloaded to disk.
overview: Virtual VOD channel/playlist library via yt-dlp

versions.changelog:
- First release.
- Follow YouTube, Twitch and Arte channels, tabs, playlists and single videos as series or movies.
- Stream on demand through yt-dlp, with nothing stored on disk.
- Quality versions, described ahead of playback so Jellyfin copies instead of transcoding.
- Multiple audio and subtitle tracks, named and filtered by preferred language.
- Live broadcasts detected within minutes, turned into replays when they end.
